crossRefs.note: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should…
He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our…
that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.

translations.web: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
translations.bsb: Teach me what I cannot see; if I have done wrong, I will not do it again.’
translations.kjv: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do
translations.asv: That which I see not teach thou me: If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more?
